text: Main entrance in the north or east direction is considered most auspicious for positive energy flow.
Kitchen should ideally be placed in the southeast direction as it is associated with fire element.
Master bedroom is best located in the southwest direction for stability and grounding energy.
Pooja room should be placed in the northeast direction for spiritual alignment and calmness.
Bathrooms should ideally be placed in the northwest or west direction to avoid energy imbalance.
Staircases should be placed in south, west, or southwest directions for structural balance.
Living room should ideally be placed in the north or east side for natural light and positivity.
Avoid placing kitchen and bathroom adjacent to each other as it creates energy imbalance in vastu principles.
Center of the house (Brahmasthan) should remain open and free from heavy structures.
Heavy furniture and storage should be placed in south or west direction for stability.
Windows in the east direction allow morning sunlight and improve positive energy flow.
Water elements like tanks or borewells should be placed in north or northeast direction.
Study or office room should ideally face east or north for better concentration and productivity.
Avoid sleeping with head towards north direction according to vastu principles.
Proper balance of five elements (earth, water, fire, air, space) is important in vastu-aligned design.
